verdict.rationale: Trivy is a locally installed CLI, distributed via brew and a Docker image. It scans images, filesystems, repos and clusters on the user's own infrastructure, and the MCP plugin also runs locally. Community users confirm running it themselves in CI, and note it ships bundled with the self-hosted Harbor registry. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party open-source license statement (only a testimonial calls it open source), and documentation of offline/air-gapped vulnerability-DB hosting or a self-hosted server mode.
